next.reason: 1985 puts each copied word in area A or B as in the library, places identifier-2/word-2/literal-2 where the matched word stood, marks debugging lines and adds continuation lines for long literals. §2023:7.2.3.4 GR11 instead: 'The resultant text after replacement shall be in logical free-form reference format', with no area or debugging-line rules. 'Library text must conform to the rules for COBOL reference format' survives as §2023:6.1 GR1 b 'A COBOL compiler shall accept source text and library text written in reference format'.
